input.query: SELECT signup_month, channel, SUM(n_signups) n_signups, SUM(n_activated) n_activated, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) activation_rate, SUM(n_email_verified)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) email_rate, SUM(n_kyc_started)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) kyc_start_rate, SUM(n_kyc_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) kyc_approval_rate, SUM(n_first_topup)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) topup_rate FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01', TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
